findings.what_changed: hold_seconds reduced 3.0 -> 2.0, derived from the start-race margin rather than copied from the reviewer's measured-passing value: the /readyz sample lands min(1.0, hold/3)s after submission and that gap must clear the real submission-to-busy latency, measured at 4.3-5.2ms typically over 15 in-process trials (one 62ms cold-interpreter outlier). hold=2.0 gives a 0.667s sample gap, ~10x the worst outlier, vs hold=1.0's 0.33s (5x the outlier) -- more margin than the value review happened to see pass, for a stated reason rather than none. Recovers ~1.0s/suite run (case cost 3.55s -> 2.51s). Re-measured the fast suite 7x post-fix: 58.69/58.79/59.05/59.27/59.96/60.44/60.59s -- still straddles 60 (2/7 over), so acceptance branch 1 (revert to 60) is not available even after the fix; branch 2 taken, WALL_BUDGET_S stays 70 (60.59 x 1.15 = 69.7 -> 70). ADR-013 Decision 4 rewritten: the false 'sweep above found no third [shape]' claim replaced with the real third shape found, what was recovered, why the rest (42.2s of deliberate bound-waiting) is irreducible by this route. fast-wall-clock-budget provenance gets falsification (5) recording the same.

The published local band is now the full post-fix 7-run set (58.69-60.59s), none omitted, and the ceiling rule is fed the slowest of those (60.59s), not a hand-picked subset. 60.59 x 1.15 = 69.7 -> 70, same number as before but now honestly derived. The pre-fix 7-run band in the same Decision 4 paragraph is left as the historical record of what was measured before this round (59.35-60.16, already the full set at the time -- R15's defect was that a later round-4 repro grabbed a cherry-picked subset of a *different*, larger history.jsonl slice than what Decision 4 actually published; Decision 4's own seven numbers were already the complete set for that measurement session).

Decision 2's '60.00/60.01' boundary text and Decision 3's 'falls back to the committed 60' text both now say the number was 60 when written and is 70 today (Decision 4). evals/run.py:75 comment fixed 'past 60s' -> 'past 70s'.
